methodology.target: Binary sign of the XAUUSD release-minute midpoint move.
methodology.selection: Choose one of four simple event rules on the pre-2021 development window only.
methodology.deployment_guard: A non-baseline event rule is promoted only if it strictly beats event-history on the 2021-2024 broad guard.
methodology.final_test: The 2024-2026 recent window is not used by selection or the broad deployment guard.

NFP.reason: candidate beat event-history on the broad guard

GDP.reason: event-history retained; candidate did not strictly improve
